Pokemon will help with construction and will contact you with requests. Set up your corner at your own pace, and then invite your friends - you can play together over a local network or online.

en.title: The Witch's Bakery [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
en.interface_lang: English [ENG] + machine translation by Larich_D for v196608
en.description:
She has one special power: she can see into people's heart and heal emotions through magic!

YOUR DAILY LIFE AS A WITCH-BAKER IN PARIS!
You play as Lunne, who has just arrived in the city! Each day is split into three phases:

-Daytime, where Lunne manages her bakery and serves clients with her team of friends.
-Evening, where Lunne explores Paris, builds relationships, discovers the city's secrets and goes inside her friends' troubled heart.
- Night, where Lunne rests, improves her magic, decorates her bakery and spends time in her cosy atelier.

The story progresses through the days as you earn experience, money, and fame, meet new friends and heal their heart.

A COLORFUL PARIS IN A JOYFUL ADVENTURE!
Once your work day is done, you can visit several districts of Paris to meet with main characters, engage in activities to learn new skills, buy books for new recipes, etc.
From typical streets of famous districts like Montmartre and the Grands Boulevards, to more intimate promenades known only by locals, Paris has many wonders to discover.Each district has its own characters, activities and shops!

A STORY ABOUT EMOTIONS AND VULNERABILITY
For some people, their emotion is locked away so strongly than Lunne needs to go inside their heart to help them. She enters their "Heart Palace", a magical space where emotions and thoughts take shape. Lunne needs to guide the personified Emotion back to the heart.

Inside the Heart Palace, Lunne discovers the person's deepest struggles and finds the key ingredient she needs to make a bread that will heal them!

en.title: Zenonia [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
en.description:
The legendary ZENONIA from the 2000s is back. The journey that began on the screens continues. Get back to your roots and experience the joy of growing your hero once again! ZENONIA returns to Switch to give you a taste of true adventure again.
The cult Action-RPG, which defined the entire genre, returns in its original form. This journey will be a valuable experience both for those who yearn to relive their favorite moments, and for those who are just discovering the origins of the cult game. The quintessential classic RPG: who will you be? Choose your calling and master one of three canonical classes:

en.title: The Noexistencen of You and Me [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
en.description:
Use "game" as a medium to showcase the world of "you/girl". Explore the truth of "you/girl/world" through the form of a "visual novel".

A surreal psychological horror short visual novel where YOU are the protagonist.

One day, a mysterious girl suddenly appears in the protagonist's room...

Your task is simple:
-Say hello to the girl~
-Navigate through hundreds of choices to respond to "the girl's existence."
-Explore the essence of "being" and uncover the truth of this "world."

And your mission is even simpler:
-Say hello to the girl~
-As king, listen to your subjects' counsel, especially those "loyal ministers."
-Make strawberry cake, eat the cake, eat the cake - will you really let her eat the cake?
-Stop FONTAINEBLEAU's plot! Don't hand over the time machine!
-Journey to the Silvery Forest, defeat the Demon Lord, fulfill the Dreamer's mission.
-Date the mysterious girl at the world's end.
-Take some pills, have a heart-to-heart chat with them.
-Witness your ending with the girl.

Of course, perhaps none of that matters most. What matters is...

I hope you enjoy our time together.

en.title: Montabi [NSZ][ENG]
en.description:
A Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.

Assemble your team of Montabi to outsmart the bad guys and save the city!

If you're going to be the big hero and save the city, you've gotta get some Montabi! Each Montabi has a unique set of skills, giving you endless combinations for team synergies. Collect equipment and charms and utilize them to chart the path to victory!  

Train your Montabi to grow stronger, unlocking new moves to enhance your team's strategy. As they level up, your Montabi evolve into more powerful forms, gaining new card abilities and expanding your tactical options. If you work together, there's nothing you and your Montabi can't achieve!

Deploy your best strategies to beat up the bad guys in a unique 3x3 grid-based system. With every Montabi's unique abilities, you'll have endless options to outthink the competition and win the day. Just make sure you rest up at a cafe every now and then to recover those hit points!

Select from diverse trainers, each with a unique playstyle. Do you wanna put your team in the perfect position, get right up in their faces and duke it out, or buff up your Montabi with a hearty meal? When the city's at stake, everyone pitches in! Just make sure to stay safe! Like the king in chess, if your trainer is defeated, the game ends.

Feature List
• Build your Montabi Team - Collect and Fight with over 60 Montabi!
• Evolve and Draft Skills - Each time you Montabi evolves, draft a legendary ability!
• Outsmart your Opponents - Strategize on the 3x3 tactical battlemap!
• Choose your Trainer - The student, fighter or chef will lead your synergistic team!

en.title: Memory of Memorie a Chill Story [NSZ][ENG]
en.description:
Through Nintendo Switch™ 2, a girl living in another world keeps you company while you work at your desk.

Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story is a work adventure where the story progresses together with the time you spend working, as you share your desk time with Memorie, an apprentice witch.

In a quiet room filled with gentle Celtic music, whenever you sit down to work, Memorie studies magic by your side.

What used to be solitary work time slowly becomes something warmer: time shared with someone.

■ The more you focus, the more the story unfolds

The game features a Pomodoro-based focus timer. As you accumulate focused work sessions, conversations with Memorie and events in her world gradually unlock.

Everyday chats.
Small changes creeping into the village.
And the secret she keeps hidden.

Beyond your work, a new piece of the story awaits.

■ Your focus changes her world

As the story progresses, Memorie's room gradually begins to change.

Her favourite cup.
The glow of magic.
A space growing warmer and richer.

The more you keep going, the more her world moves forward too.

■ Features

・A cozy fantasy workspace with Celtic music and ambient sounds
・A Pomodoro-technique-based focus timer
・Story and world mysteries unlocked through your focus time
・A room that changes as the story progresses
・A calendar system to track your daily focus
・A companion for studying, working, creative projects, and all kinds of desk work

■ The World

The story takes place in Elmana Village, a small settlement not far from the Imperial Capital. It is a peaceful place protected by the sacred Lightroot Tree.

But little by little, a dark presence begins to creep into the world.

Using a spell that connects distant people, Memorie found you. Was it coincidence, or...?

Stay focused, and see the story through to its ending together.

en.title: Avatar Legends the Fighting Game [NSZ][ENG]
en.description:
Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation faithful to the series’ roots, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game lets you experience the world of Avatar like never before. Choose from 12 playable characters and go head-to-head across a variety of modes, including Offline & Online Versus, Story, Arcade, Training, Spectator, and an Art Gallery.

Standard Edition: 
 
•  Hand-Drawn 2D Animation
Hand-drawn 2D animation faithfully brings characters and their unique fighting styles from Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Legend of Korra, and the expanded universe to life.

• A Wealth of Game Modes
Includes Story Mode, Arcade Mode, Offline & Online Play, Training Mode, Spectator Mode, an Art Gallery featuring never-before-seen concept art.

•  Story and Arcade Mode
Experience an all-new original story outlined by show creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Tim Hedrick. Shape the fate of time and space in the main story mode, then dive into arcade runs featuring storylines for every playable character.

• Robust Training Mode
A Training Mode equips players of all skill levels with advanced tools, including hitboxes, frame data, save states, and more.

• Art Gallery
Explore never-before-seen original artwork from the show, honoring the history, characters, and world of Avatar.

• Easy to Pick Up, Impossible to Put Down
Anyone can start bending with simple, intuitive controls, perfect for quick matches with friends and family. Beneath the surface lies a deep fighting system rewarding technical prowess and creativity.

• Seamless Online Play
Battle players worldwide with rollback netcode and crossplay across multiple platforms. Ranked and Casual matches, lobbies, spectator mode, replays, and more ensure a competitive experience no matter where you are or who you’re fighting.

Gameplay Features

• Master Flow and Energy Points
Control the fight by using Flow to dash, evade, and outmaneuver opponents with high-speed mobility, then build Energy Points through skilled play to unleash enhanced special moves and powerful cinematic Super Arts that can turn the tide of battle.

• Support Characters
Choose from three support characters to accompany your fighter, each providing unique abilities that enhance different strengths and open up new strategic possibilities. Experiment with combinations and discover the partnership that best fits your style.

en.title: Moonlight Peaks [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
en.interface_lang: English [ENG] + machine translation by Larich_D for v196608
en.description:
Experience life as a vampire in a magical town full of werewolves, witches, mermaids, and more! In this heart-warming, supernatural life-sim, you will raise mystical crops, learn spell-casting and potion-making, and befriend – or even romance – the locals. And at the same time, show your skeptical father that a life of compassion is possible – even for the undead.

Settle down in your family’s abandoned homestead and make it your own. Build your farm with magic crops and livestock, customize your cottage with gothic style, and make friends with other creatures of the night. Embrace immortality and unlock ancient abilities, all in the name of a more bountiful harvest. Unravel the mysteries of the seven families that inhabit Moonlight Peaks and bring a bit of light back to this spooky settlement. Just remember to be back in your coffin before the sun comes up!

Key Features
■Uncover a Sweet and Spooky Journey
Customize your perfect vampire persona and build relationships with the people of Moonlight Peaks to learn more about the town’s history. Uncover the secrets of the seven families who dwell there – and maybe even find your “tomb” love from any of the two dozen romanceable characters in the process.

■Build Your Dream Gothic Farmstead
Design your cozy gothic homestead, turning a forgotten farm into the ideal sanctuary. Obtain new tools and develop your property to grow even more enchanted crops and raise magical livestock.

■Harness Magical Powers
Embrace your supernatural lineage! Shapeshift into other forms to explore all the town has to offer, and study witchcraft to learn spells that will help you on the farm or when gathering resources. 

■Delight in Dark Diversions
Beyond the farm, you’ll be able to enjoy fishing, foraging, and potion-crafting, along with activities like embroidering, flower arranging, and more. You can even collect cards for the town’s favorite game, Nokturna, to play against other residents.

en.title: Bang Bang Bandits [NSZ][ENG]
en.description:
BANG! BANG! BANDITS, the party-style gun shooting game that the whole family can enjoy, is now available as the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition!

Set in a bright and pop world with simple controls anyone can master, this title has been further powered up by the performance of the Nintendo Switch 2.

With new support for GameShare, you can now easily play together not only with those nearby but also with people far away. Furthermore, the visuals have evolved to be even more beautiful and vivid! Enjoy an even more thrilling gameplay experience on a high-impact screen with silky-smooth motion.

■Intuitive controls that require zero explanation! Anyone can play immediately!
Simple controls: just hold the Joy-Con™ in one hand as a handgun and aim and shoot at the enemies on the screen!!
Automatically move around the field, aim and shoot at all the enemies that appear, and collect lots and lots of coins!
There is no bullet limit, so you can fire as much as you want!
There's nothing to it, just shoot away!

■12 types of stages x 2 leagues, for a lot of fun to be had!
The Normal League, where the battles take place, has 12 stages with different characteristics, including jungles, urban areas, ruins, and caves.
Once you've conquered all the stages in the Normal League, you can challenge the Wild League, which is the most difficult mode available!

■Unique enemy characters run amok all over the screen!
Defeat the Goomin that attack you one after another, and defeat the evil boss waiting at the end of the stage!

■Enjoy 2 different ways to play: Challenge Mode and Battle Mode! 
Start with low-class stages in Challenge Mode and then conquer the most difficult stages.
You can play alone or in a team of 2 to 4 people! If each player has a Joy-Con, you can enjoy competitive play, such as single battles (individual battles) where 2-4 players compete for the highest score, or team battles where 2 teams of 2 players compete for the highest score!

en.title: Gurei [NSZ][RUS/Multi7]
en.description:
Overview

Rei, the main character, is a human spirit bound with the challenging duty of defeating mystical entities of nature, the Kami, to obtain their power.

You are free to pick your fights against the Kami in any order. The game features a dynamic difficulty system where each enemy strength is defined by the player’s chosen path. This means that the very same Kami fought at the very beginning could also be the final boss in a different route. Hope to never leave the one you struggle most to fight last!

Combat Features

Besides sword attacks, dodges, head stomps and other basic abilities, Rei will learn a completely new skill for each defeated Kami. Those will provide further depth to your combat arsenal, be it a stronger dash, a weapon that can execute enemies, the ability to heal and many more! 

Player choice is the ultimate power. Taking into account the vastly distinct enemies’ patterns and unique skills granted upon each victory, you will be able to decide how to approach every challenge. It won’t be easy either way, but you can always go back and try something different.

Beyond the Brawl

Gurei is a game about fighting strong enemies, but that’s not all. The Kami inhabit a surreal castle located between the human and spirit worlds. After each victory, Rei comes closer to the realm of spirits, starting to encounter peculiar characters from Japanese mythology. These creatures will add novelty and strangeness to your journey, providing commentary, unique animations, side objectives and obscure secrets.

Unlikely “Friends”

You will get to know the different Kami quite well. When Rei defeats them, she absorbs their power – and their personality. The defeated Kami will be carried around wherever Rei goes, and they’ll surely have stuff to talk about. Sometimes their remarks will be useful information that builds the player’s understanding of the lore and the game mechanics, but sometimes they will be... not so helpful, to put it briefly. Good luck!

en.title: Laysara Summit Kingdom [NSP][ENG]
en.interface_lang: English [ENG] + LFS-translation by LiaNdrY, Tekatai, port AlchemistLab for v196608
en.description:
Laysara: Summit Kingdom is a challenging city builder which tasks you with creating a new home for your people forced out of the lowlands. During a campaign or sandbox playthrough, you will establish multiple towns, each on a unique mountain with its own traits. All your towns co-exist in symbiosis, creating a trading network, which you can then adjust to your needs by revisiting already developed settlements. The Kingdom of Laysara has to be rebuilt!

BUILD ON A MOUNTAIN
Each mountain comes with a new set of challenges. Mounts differ in shapes, vegetation zone layouts, resource availability and weather conditions. Sometimes you will have plenty of room for farming in green lowlands, sometimes you will need to rely on breeding and extracting valuable minerals from regions dangerously close to peak glaciers. If you find yourself in dire need of a certain resource, you can always try to establish a trading route with another town.

DEAL WITH AVALANCHES
One of the ever-present dangers you will have to deal with are mighty avalanches. You can’t stop them, but you can take precautions and be prepared. Afforest the key areas to create natural barriers, build artificial ones to redirect rushing masses of snow, or trigger the avalanche early, while it’s still manageable. Create a deliberate and reliable strategy and you might even be able to use the power of snow to your advantage; fail to do so and find your city buried and devastated!

CRAFT A TRANSPORT NETWORK
So, transporting goods is easy, right? Well, not if your destination lies on the other side of the mountain, a few hundred meters higher, behind cliffs, ridges, canyons and rivers. You will need to create a vast, complex transport network consisting of roads, bridges and shafts to ensure reliable delivery chains. As demand for resources will grow alongside the town’s population, always look for opportunities to optimise your transportation network, be it by building paved roads, using more advanced lifting constructions, or aiding your carriers with glamorous yaks.

RAISE A SUMMIT TEMPLE
If you manage to endure all mountain dangers, build a network of efficient production chains and satisfy all needs of your people, there is only one more thing to be done: conquering the mountain peak! To succeed in this great endeavour you’ll need to reach the summit and establish safe routes for your carriers to bring in enormous amounts of building resources, but beware! Weather at this height is as deadly as ever. The final effect is well worth the effort though, as raising the summit temple is an act of total triumph of human courage (and your logistics skills!) over the elements.

Final note: the game is a pure city building experience solely focused on the economy, resource management and surviving despite the inhospitable environment. Therefore, the game doesn’t feature combat or any other military aspects.

en.title: Dispatch [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
en.voice_lang: English + Russian for 1-2-3 glav by NikiStudio
en.description:
Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy set in modern day Los Angeles from the writers and directors of Tales from the Borderlands and The Wolf Among Us, and features an all-star cast including Aaron Paul, Laura Bailey, and Jeffrey Wright.

Note: Some mature content from Dispatch's original version has been modified. 

You play as Robert Robertson, AKA Mecha Man, whose mech-suit is destroyed in a battle against his nemesis, forcing him to take a job at a superhero dispatch center: not as a hero, but a dispatcher.

As their dispatcher, you take charge of a team of ex-supervillains given a shot at redemption. Manage and level up your roster, all while navigating office relationships and romances, and rebuilding your suit for a shot at revenge!

> Shape the Story

In Dispatch, every decision you make influences the unfolding narrative. From banter in the breakroom to life-or-death situations in the field, your choices affect your relationships with the heroes, their allegiances, and the path your own story takes.

>  Deploy Your Heroes 

Use the strategy map to review ongoing emergencies and deploy the right (or wrong) heroes to deal with them. Balance the risks and rewards as you make tactical decisions, knowing that each choice can have lasting consequences for your team and the city.

> Manage Your Roster

Managing heroes sometimes goes beyond their powers. Each hero comes with quirks, flaws, and baggage you’ll need to navigate to keep the team together. Upgrade their skills and unlock abilities to boost their effectiveness in the field.

Blending narrative, strategy, and humor, Dispatch explores what it means to be a hero, whether you're wearing a cape or behind a desk.

Featuring an all-star cast from every corner of entertainment:

Aaron Paul (Breaking Bad, Westworld, Black Mirror)
Laura Bailey (The Legend of Vox Machina, The Last of Us II, Marvel's Spider-Man)
Erin Yvette (Hades II, The Wolf Among Us, Armored Core VI: Fires of Rubicon)
MoistCr1TiKaL (Charles White) 
Jacksepticeye (Sonic Prime, River City Girls 1 & 2, Bendy and the Ink Machine)
Travis Willingham (The Legend of Vox Machina, Critical Role, Lego Avengers)
Alanah Pearce (V/H/S Beyond, Cyberpunk 2077, Gears 5)
Lance Cantstopolis (Karate, Dancing, Actor)
Joel Haver (Filmmaker, Actor, YouTuber)
THOT SQUAD (Musician: Pound Cake, Hoes Depressed)
Yung Gravy (Musician: Betty (Get Money), oops!)
Matthew Mercer (Critical Role, Overwatch, Resident Evil 6)
and Jeffrey Wright (American Fiction, The Batman, Casino Royale)

en.title: Urban Myth Dissolution Center [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
en.description:
The Urban Myth Dissolution Center – your one-stop solution for dissolving and dealing with cursed relics, monstrous oddities, and dimensional anomalies!
Take on cases revolving around urban myths as Azami Fukurai, the heroine, under the supervision of Ayumu Meguriya, Level S psychic and Center Director...

■Game Overview
The game takes you on an episodic digital mystery adventure, exploring various urban myths that haunt the internet, all presented in stunning psychedelic pixel art.

The player takes control of Azami for the detective legwork, collecting circumstantial evidence and social network posts to unravel the truth behind each urban myth, as well as the hidden pasts of each client, and why they came to encounter each oddity. The dissolution of each urban myth leads to unexpected consequences and hidden truths...

■The Urban Myth Dissolution Center
The Urban Myth Dissolution Center is a privately owned institution specializing in adaptive researchーboth onsite and onlineー, collection, and psychic divination, led by Center Director Ayumu Meguriya, focusing on the numerous urban myths that roam the offline and online worlds.

en.title: Hello Kitty Island Adventure Deluxe edition + DLC The Tea Garden, City Town, Wheatflour Wonderland [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
en.description:
•  Discover eight unique regions, from the ocean’s depths to an island in the clouds 
•  Befriend iconic characters like cheerful Hello Kitty, mischievous Kuromi and sweet Cinnamoroll
•  Bake, cook and craft the perfect gifts to become best friends
•  Renovate cabins and decorate them to attract even more wonderful characters
•  Create your perfect avatar, find and customise hundreds of outfits tailored to you, and create and collect furniture to achieve your dream home aesthetic
•  Celebrate the joys of summertime, the winter holidays and more with a year round calendar of events And don’t forget to throw birthday parties for your friends
•  Solve hidden puzzles, catch cute critters, and garden to fill the world with flowers
•  Dive into a multiplayer game with real-world friends and family: team up to explore, get bonuses, and take sweet snapshots together

en.title: Ravenswatch + 10 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
en.description:
Choose a side and show your support for the game with the Legendary Edition.
Includes:
* Ravenswatch game
* Ravens Skin Pack: 9 exclusive Ravenswatch-themed outfits for Scarlet, Beowulf, Snow Queen, Pied Piper, Aladdin, Geppetto, Sun Wukong, Melusine and Carmilla. Available from the hero selection menu.
* Nightmares Skin Pack: 9 exclusive Nightmare-themed outfits for the same heroes and available from the same menu.

en.title: Boomerang Fu + 3 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi17]
en.description:
Join a crew of your favorite foods as you grill, chill and spill your enemies. Discover ridiculous power-ups and stack them together in deadly combinations to become the ultimate Boomerang Fu master.

LOCAL MULTIPLAYER CHAOS
Roast and toast your friends in lightning-fast rounds of cute physics combat for up to 6 players. Perfect for parties!

STACK POWER-UPS TOGETHER
Discover a ridiculous range of power-ups like explosive boomerangs, disguises and telekinesis. Then stack your power-ups together to form outrageous combinations!

TEAM UP
Join forces with your friends to take on the ingenious AI opponents in couch co-op mode.

HIDE AND SEEK
Scramble to find the perfect hiding spot or hunt down your friends in this tense game mode.

SIMPLE CONTROLS
It only takes one stick and three buttons to pulverize your pals. Anyone can play immediately, but hardcore players will love mastering the advanced techniques of this lost martial art. Deflect attacks, recall dropped boomerangs, and curve your throws around corners to become a powerful boomerang assassin.

OVER 30 ARENAS
Journey to an edible world as you do battle in over 30 Kung Fu arenas, each filled with unique tools and traps. Jump over moving platforms and sneak through lush foliage. Trigger sliding walls to squish your foes. Dive between giant rolling pins and delight the Toaster King.

CHANGE THE RULES
Play with only the power-ups you love. Turn off shields. Turn on friendly fire. You change the rules to suit your tastes!

UNLOCK COSTUMES
Earn experience points every time you play to unlock new hats and outfits for your favourite foods.

en.title: Uno + 14 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
en.description:
Step into one of the most beloved card games that we all grew up with! Match cards by color, number, or symbol, play action cards to spice things up, and race against others to empty your hand first. Don’t forget to shout “UNO!” when you’re down to your last card!

Play locally or online with up to 4 players: Track your progress on global and weekly leaderboards, gain levels, and earn special Medals to show off to your opponents!

Choose from a variety of beloved House Rules: Customize your game with options like Stacking, Jump-In, and the 7-0 cards rules. You can even combine them to maximize the fun!

Create your unique game space with MyDesign: Personalize your experience with colorful boards, card decks, music, avatars, and more. Unlock new items by playing any game mode and build your own UNO™ game world!

Jump into the action with exclusive features: Discover the thrill of Happy Hour, where you can play a selected DLC for free during limited time periods, bringing fresh gameplay with each session. Don’t miss out—your next favorite add-on is just a Happy Hour away!

And, if you’re a Twitch fan, engage with your favorite streamers using the interactive Twitch Extension—now you can influence the game by predicting the winner and placing your votes on which card to play or color to choose!

Internet connection, Ubisoft Account, applicable platform account, and platform subscription (sold separately) required to access online multiplayer/features.

en.title: Mario Kart World [NUP][RUS/Multi12]
en.description: Hit the open road with Mario and friends! Zip along courses on a vast world where everything is connected. Race around grassy plains, bustling cities, wide-open waters, big ol' volcanos, and more...plus everything in-between. Exclusively for Nintendo Switch 2!

en.title: Another Eden Begins [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
en.interface_lang: English [ENG] + optional machine translation by yuracher for v131072
en.description:
A time-traveling RPG adventure from Masato Kato, creator of countless classic RPGs
Product Summary
Aldo embarks on an adventure beyond time and space to save his sister, Feinne, from the clutches of the beastfolk.

A richly woven tale by scenario writer and director, Masato Kato, unfolds across the ages, alongside a main theme composed by Yasunori Mitsuda, music incorporating traditional folk instruments and an orchestra by Procyon Studios, and a stellar voice cast.

The strategic command battles, which feature exhilarating actions like chain skills that trigger successive strikes, and Another Force that allows a barrage of attacks, can be fought with original parties composed from a total of 19 characters.

After clearing the main story, New Game+ offers a new adventure filled with new faces and over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆Strategic Command Battles
The lands of Another Eden are rife with monsters—run into them to initiate a command-based battle and take them down.
Create your own original parties, unleash chain skills, and create chains to trigger successive strikes!
Unleash a flurry of attacks with Another Force to beat your enemy into submission!

◆Befriend and Forge Meaningful Bonds with 18 Allies
18 allies of different races and eras await Aldo on his journey.
Allies' stories are told through various quests. Encounter quests depict their first meeting with Aldo, character quests reveal their past and purpose, and kinship quests explore their relationship with Aldo.

◆Embark on a New Adventure with New Game+
Complete the main story to unlock New Game+ and embark on a new adventure with your allies as they are!
New Game+ also introduces a brand-new character, Ramiu, and features over 10 different endings based on your actions and choices.

◆New Features to Enrich Your Time-Traveling Adventure
Enrich your adventure beyond time and space by logging the feline friends you encounter in the cat catalog, and creating weapons, armor, and food from different eras with the crafting feature.

en.title: Sonic Racing Crossworlds + 8 DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
en.voice_lang: Japanese, English, French, German, Spanish, Italian
en.description:
**To access the Digital Deluxe Edition content on Nintendo Switch™ 2, please purchase the Nintendo Switch™ Digital Deluxe Edition and the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition Upgrade Pack. Existing owners of the Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition can also access the Digital Deluxe Edition content by purchasing the Season Pass for Nintendo Switch™.

Race across land, sea, air, and space in Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds! Warp through Travel Rings into new dimensions where something new awaits around every twist and turn.  

Speed to victory solo or as a team in a variety of offline and online modes and compete against players from around the world. Build the ultimate vehicle to match your racing style, unlock gadgets to gain the upper hand, and unleash power-up items to bring home the win!

Ready, Set, Warp!   
Race across 24 tracks and warp to 15 CrossWorlds with Travel Rings, a unique gameplay mechanic that transports the iconic characters from the Sonic and SEGA universes into new dimensions. Use unpredictability to your advantage as you change the landscape of each race!  

Race With the Best!
Choose from 23 iconic Sonic characters, the largest roster of any Sonic racing game! 

Make It Yours  
Mix and match between 45 unique original vehicles and 70 different gadgets to trick out your ride, level up your kart, and create the ultimate machine to match your racing style. 

Gain the Advantage with Powerful Items!  
Dominate your opponents with 23 different items including returning favorites and all-new items like the Monster Truck!  

Multiple Ways to Play  
Gather with friends and play local split-screen in Grand Prix and the new party mode Race Park, compete against players from around the world and increase your rank in World Match, play against friends online in 12-player lobbies with custom rules in Friend Match, or test your driving skills in Time Trials.

en.title: Dog Man Mission Impawsible / Bark in Action [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
en.interface_lang: English [ENG] + machine translation by most2820 for pervoy chasti
en.description:
A comic-book style game packed with action, humor, boss fights, and ability-granting gadgets. Play as 10 different characters from the comics, each with unique powers.  

A hero is needed! Dr. Scum has set up Hypno Screens around the city, mind-controlling the innocent townsfolk. Now it’s up to Dog Man - part Dog, part Man- to fight back against Dr. Scum and all his minions. Defeat Dr. Scum, save your friends, and rescue the city!  

A game based on the wonderful Dog Man comic books by artist Dav Pilkey, also known for Captain Underpants. 
 
Bark in Action Features:  

Work Together with the Supa Buddies 
Switch between Dog Man and his Supa Buddies: Dog Man, Li'l Petey, 80-HD. Each has their own special abilities, to overcome obstacles and defeat Dr. Scum.  Phone in Friends to help you, like Commander Cupcake or Chief, for a total of 10 playable characters! 
 
Explore 60 Action Packed Levels 
Explore iconic locations from the Dog Man universe, such as the Cat Jail and Robo-Time Industries. Beat the clock in the Time Challenges, and discover the Mystery Levels full of surprises! 
 
Play Solo or with a Friend 
Double the action by having a second player join with unique special abilities. Couch co-op the whole family can enjoy! 
 
Discover Unlockable Outfits and Supa Gadgets 
Collect sprockets to unlock crazy Gadgets. Collect yarn to craft cool new outfits like the Scarlet Shedder, Cat Kid and much more! 
 
Stand up to Villains 
Use each character's signature fighting move to take down Dr. Scum's minions and the Supa-Bad-Guy himself. Use clever teamwork to beat bosses!

en.title: To the Moon / Finding Paradise / A Bird Story / Sigmund Minisode 1 i 2 Holiday Special [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
en.description:
A playful journey about two doctors navigating through the memories of a dying man in an attempt to artificially fulfill his last wish...
Dr. Rosalyn and Dr. Watts have an unusual job: they give patients the chance to live their lives all over again, from the very beginning... but only in their minds.

en.title: We Are Eva [NSP][ENG]
en.description:
Play in multiple dimensions at once, moving freely between them in this unusual 2D platformer that blurs all possible boundaries.
I am Eva, and I promise: it will be fun! Or maybe, maybe we will both suffer terribly... How should I know? I'm just a video game character. Are you still reading this? Wow! As I said, my name is Eva. I am the main character of the game you are looking at now. Yes, this little platformer is about me and traveling between dimensions! Want to know more? Well... I am a peaceful creature living between different worlds. Usually all I do is sleep, but now something bad is happening to these worlds, and I want to stop it.
There is no more time for explanations!..

en.title: Journey to the Void [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
en.description:
In this hybrid strategy roguelite deck builder, you must protect your hero from hordes of enemies in a grid-based combat system. Prepare to fend off attacks from all directions as you remain stationary at the centre of the battlefield. Use your action cards wisely, strategically combining energy, cards, effects, and knowledge of your enemies to overcome the odds.

Stand Your Ground
What do you get when an unstoppable force meets an unmovable object? Chaos, and lots of it. With 100+ different cards, items and weapons with unique effect combinations, you’ll craft the ultimate stalwart against the forces of corruption. Build deck synergies and choose key skills upgrades as you set out to save the world. 

Dust Yourself Off
Decide your character’s journey. Trade with merchants, be faced with moral decisions along the way, and shape your hero’s adventure. Unlock unique hero backgrounds that alter your starting deck and can impact the strategy of your run each time you play. 

Brave A New World
The world, divided into eight elemental regions, will permanently react to the multitude of choices you make. Each time you play, experience completely unique runs within an overarching story, with over 100 enemies, 9 bosses, different starting decks and 25 arenas to discover.

en.title: Dicevaders (Dice Vaders) [NSZ][ENG]
en.description: A new deck-building game where you lead an alien invasion in the StarVaders universe. Learn to control the dice, assemble an invincible army, and unleash epic combos with powerful synergies and clever moves.

en.title: Tape to Tape [NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
en.interface_lang: English [ENG] + Russian mashinnyy by most2820 for v0
en.description:
Explore the magnificent world of roguelike hockey, where every choice matters on the path to returning hockey to its former glory. Recruit unique players, manage your defenders, find synergies between them, choose new abilities, bribe judges, visit a blade master for upgrades and much more.
BUILD YOUR TEAM

en.title: Bluey's Happy Snaps [XCI][ENG]
en.description:
Play, explore, and capture moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered adventure across familiar spots from the show. Snap memories solo or side-by-side with a second player, discover Australian wildlife, and turn in-game moments into real fun for Real Life.

Say Cheese!
Bluey and Bingo have found Dad's old camera (back from when he was cool). Take it with you around Bluey's hometown of Brisbane as you snap photos of the games you play, chase bin chickens and uncover hidden surprises. Each snapshot is saved to your own scrapbook, where you can keep your best moments.

Fun for Everyone
A second player can join in to explore and strike a pose, while the main player leads the adventure behind the camera. Hang out with Muffin, Chloe, Winton and more of Bluey's friends wherever you go, playing with loads of toys and jumping into games from the show, like Shadowlands and Magic Cauldron. 

Play for Real Life
Packed with tips that turn game time into play for Real Life time! Find new ways to play with everyday things in the world around you, turning cushion forts and cardboard boxes into the next big adventure. Kids can explore, play and discover in the game, then take it off the screen and keep the fun going.

Snap, Capture, and Collect
Build your scrapbook one snap at a time. Every photo unlocks stickers inspired by the friends, wildlife, and games you come across. Arrange these stickers, paint them however you like, and dress up Bluey and Bingo with costumes you unlock along the way.

Bluey's Happy Snaps has no in-game purchases and no online play.

en.title: Alien Quest Eve (homebrew) [NSZ][ENG]
en.description:
«Zhenshchina, vidish li, eto takoy predmet, chto, skolko ty ni izuchay eyo, vsyo budet sovershenno novoe.» ©
Zakhvatyvayushchaya indi eroge-metroidvaniya, polnaya ekshona, strelby, platforminga i zharkogo seksa, gde vragi zhazhdut ne tolko ubit vas, no zaodno i gryazno nadrugatsya nad prekrasnoy glavnoy geroiney!..
V osnove syuzheta lezhit nekaya nauchno-issledovatelskaya baza, gde zhivyot ogromnyy mozgovoy monstr, kotoryy nachal buystvovat, kak i mnozhestvo melkikh sushchestv ryadom.
Edinstvennaya, kto mozhet spasti polozhenie — tolko voskhititelnaya Ellen!

en.title: Village in the Shade [NSP][ENG]
en.description:
Welcome to Kagatsu, a Japanese mountain village with plenty of secrets. In this  brand-new, hand-painted farming sim, you'll plant crops, customize your homestead, and meet a cast of intriguing characters—all with something to hide.

Enjoy quiet countryside living...as long as you follow the rules.

en.title: Ice Age 2 the Meltdown (port ) [NRO][RUS]
en.description: Help a motley crew of animals driven by global warming and get to land, where they will no longer be pursued by endless dangers. In addition to the original gameplay, The Meltdown also offers a bunch of different mini-games that can diversify our time in the virtual world and amuse children.

en.title: Dark Souls II (2) Scholar of the First Sin (port ) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.description:
DARK SOULS™ II: Scholar of the First Sin is the most complete edition of the acclaimed role-playing game DARK SOULS™ II, including all previously released content and additions.
An unforgettable journey awaits you through a huge and mysterious world, where deadly opponents, treacherous traps and unpredictable challenges lurk around every turn. Every encounter could be your last, and every victory will require endurance, skill and determination. Explore the dark lands of Drangleic, fight powerful bosses, collect souls and try to find a way to get rid of the ancient curse that condemns you to an eternal journey between life and death.
Scholar of the First Sin offers a completely new gaming experience: the placement of enemies and objects has been redesigned, new dangers and characters have appeared, and the usual safe places no longer guarantee salvation. The game also includes three major expansions - Crown of the Sunken King, Crown of the Old Iron King and Crown of the Ivory King.
Prepare to face death again.
In the world of DARK SOULS II, every step is a test, and every victory comes at a high price.

en.title: Call of Duty Classic (homebrew) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.description:
Call of Duty is a 2003 first-person shooter video game developed by Infinity Ward and published by Activision. It is the first installment in the Call of Duty franchise and was released on October 29, 2003 for Microsoft Windows. The game simulates infantry and general warfare of World War II using a modified version of the id Tech 3 engine. Much of its theme and gameplay is similar to the Medal of Honor series; however, Call of Duty showcases the multiple points of view represented in the American, British, and Soviet World War II campaigns in Europe.
The game introduced a new approach to AI-controlled allies that support the player during missions and react to changes in the situation during the game. This led to a greater emphasis on team play, as opposed to the "lone wolf" approach often found in early first-person shooters. Most of Infinity Ward's development team consisted of people involved in the development of Medal of Honor: Allied Assault. Upon release, the game received universal acclaim and won several Game of the Year awards. However, retrospective reviews were less favorable, with many critics arguing that the game had not held up well over time; it ranked low in the ratings of games in the series.

en.title: Silent Hill: Downpour (homebrew) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.description: A prison bus crashes on the way out of Rikers, leaving prisoner Murphy Pendleton alone on the road outside Silent Hill. The city greets him with rain, which blurs the boundary between reality and something else: as soon as the downpour intensifies, the streets are rewritten anew, and out of the fog comes out what the city pulled from his memory. Murphy is looking for a way out and along the way finds out what he was really imprisoned for.

en.title: Dead Space 2 (homebrew) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.description:
The action of this part of the game takes place in 2511, three years after the events on the space ripper "Ishimura" and immediately after the sabotage on the densely populated space station-metropolis "Cluster", located on the fragments of the Titan satellite in the orbit of Saturn. The station's psychiatric hospital houses a former C.E.C. engineer. Isaac Clarke (after he was found unconscious in the drifting shuttle on which he escaped from Aegis 7). For all three years, his life was artificially supported, since he never regained consciousness. Awakened by Franco, Clark again finds himself surrounded by necromorphs, which are spreading throughout the metropolis.
However, before Franco can free Isaac from the straitjacket, he is killed by the Corruptor and turned into a dismemberer in front of the main character, after which Isaac is forced to flee!
The game was very positively assessed by leading gaming publications, the average rating on Metacritic was 87-90 points out of a possible 100, PSM3 magazine rated the game 92%, Official Xbox Magazine - 9.5 out of 10 points, Game Informer - 9 out of 10 points, Official Xbox Magazine UK - 9 out of 10. Previous parts: “Dead Space: Sabotage” and “Dead Space 1” see here

en.title: Silent Hill Decompilation NX (homebrew) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
en.interface_lang: Russian (by ViT Co Metallist + Team Raccoon), English [RUS / ENG]
en.voice_lang: Russian (ozv. Andrey Maslov, Anna Chintsova, Angelina Gundorina, Ekaterina Dmitrova, Ruta Nyattieva i dr.), English
en.description:
The game takes place in 1983 in the small town of Silent Hill, located in Maine, USA. 32-year-old writer Harry Mason goes to the city with his adopted daughter Cheryl to spend a vacation there. When approaching the city, the writer's car is overtaken by Sybil Bennett's police motorcycle, but at the next turn Harry sees it overturned on the side of the road. Distracted by him, Harry notices too late a girl who has suddenly appeared on the road. Trying to avoid a collision, he sharply turns the steering wheel, gets into an accident and loses consciousness.
Silent Hill is a 1999 survival horror video game that spawned the video game series of the same name. Developed by Team Silent, a group within Konami Computer Entertainment Tokyo, and published by Konami exclusively for the PlayStation video game console. Silent Hill uses a 3rd person view, all locations are made in three-dimensional graphics. To hide the graphical shortcomings caused by the technical limitations of the PlayStation, the developers used the “fog effect”, which later became a distinctive feature of the world of Silent Hill. Unlike earlier survival horror games, in which the main characters, as a rule, were special agents with good combat training, the character of Silent Hill is an ordinary person. The game has five different endings, including one humorous one.
Silent Hill received positive reviews from critics and was commercially successful. The game is considered one of the most significant among the survival horror genre, as in terms of intimidating the player, it contributed to the transition from B-movie techniques to the psychological aspect of horror.
"Silent Hill 2" and "Silent Hill 3" here.

en.title: 49 Keys (Forty Nine Chiavi) [NSZ][ENG]
en.developer: Michele Buonanno, Veronica Wu, Fabio Porfidia
en.description:
49 Keys is a narrative-focused game that will test your wits and nerves. Peruse the pages of a Lovecraftian tale, interact with maps and solve the puzzles encountered along the way. Trace your master's footsteps to uncover the deepest secrets of the arcane, on a quest brimming with horror and magic.


Embark on a Disturbing Journey
Alas, I knew not of the extraordinary, bizarre, and gut-churning sights that awaited within those walls.

The year is 1520. You receive a letter from your old mentor, the first step on an unnerving journey like none before. One that shall expose you to the forbidden arcane and all its mystery in which you shall concoct mixtures both wondrous and strange, and summon forth beings of other-worldly power. You must steel yourself, for terrors buried deep within shall soon awaken within you, Dantean horrors that bleed into reality. Endure these trials and, in time, the truth shall draw near. Yet will you be brave enough to pay its price?

An Immersive Literary Feat
Its lauded writing aside, 49 Keys is an audio-visual work of art. Intricately-designed menus hark back to manuscripts of the Middle Ages through to the Renaissance, with a unique art style throughout. Pore over incredible full-colour illustrations, and feel the thrill as original themes perfectly complement each twist and turn. All this combines for a deeply immersive world.

Unique Riddles and Marvellous Mysteries
Akin to point-and-click adventures, 49 Keys has you search through a meticulously-crafted world collecting items to aid you in solving its myriad puzzles. Read every word with care, for vital clues are hidden within. Put your reasoning skills to the test, and push onward; but fear not—an array of detailed in-game tips are at hand, if ever you need them.

Directly Adapted From The Best-Seller
49 Keys was developed and adapted by the original author behind the 2022 gamebook of the same name (49 Chiavi), a best-selling puzzle adventure. Gaining overwhelming praise from critics, it also achieved a place on Italy's 2022 gamebook best-seller list, going on to win two highly-coveted awards that year.

en.title: Romancing SaGa Minstrel Song Remastered International [NSP][ENG]
en.description:
The gods created man and man created stories. The primordial creator Marda brought forth the land of Mardias. In ages past a mighty battle rocked this land, when Elore, the king of the gods, fought three malicious deities: Death, Saruin and Schirach. After a long and drawn-out struggle, Death and Schirach were sealed away and rendered powerless, with the final deity Saruin also trapped through the power of the Fatestones and the noble sacrifice of the hero Mirsa.

Now 1,000 years have passed since that titanic battle. The Fatestones lie scattered across the world and the gods of evil are resurgent once more. Eight heroes set off on their own journeys, as if guided by the hand of fate. What tales will these adventurers weave across the vast tapestry of Mardias? You are the only one who can decide!

The original Romancing SaGa -Minstrel Song- included many of the SaGa series trademark elements, such as the Glimmer and Combo mechanics and was considered to be the epitome of the series when it first released. The free scenario system that lets you create your own storyline remains at the core of the game, letting you select one of eight protagonists with completely different origins and backstories, then set off on a unique journey. This remastered edition has evolved in all areas, featuring upgraded HD graphics and numerous enhancements to improve playability. And for the first time ever, the game will be fully playable in French, German, Italian and Spanish. This makes it highly recommended for both fans of the original and newcomers to the SaGa series.

Features
•	Brand new localization in French, German, Italian and Spanish (English also included)
•	Full HD graphical update
•	Schiele, Marina, Monica and Flammar can now be recruited
•	Enhanced and more difficult bosses
•	High speed mode
•	Mini Maps
•	New Game+ mode

en.title: Marenian Tavern Story: Patty and the Hungry God [NSZ][ENG]
en.description:
Patty's brother has been possessed by the God of Poverty and the whole family has become poor, with huge debts... This is the beginning of Patty's struggle! To pay back the debts, let's open a tavern in Marenia, gather ingredients, and start cooking!

Run the adventure tavern how you like! Collect ingredients and cook new dishes above 600! You get level ups not by defeating monsters, but by eating food. Train your characters, conquer new dungeons, and aim to get new ingredients through exploration, farming, fishing, and many more ways!

What will your tavern be like?

es.title: Yoshi and the Mysterious Book [NUP][ENG]
es.description:
Un día, un libro llamado Mister E cayó sobre estas tierras, donde viven los dinosaurios Yoshi. Esta enciclopedia describió varias criaturas. ¡Impulsado por la curiosidad, Yoshi se sumergió en el mundo del conocimiento!
El juego se anunció en una presentación de Nintendo Direct el 12 de septiembre de 2025, como parte de la celebración del 40 aniversario de la serie Super Mario Bros., el primer juego se lanzó en 1985. Yoshi and the Mysterious Book es un juego de plataformas de desplazamiento lateral ambientado dentro de una enciclopedia viviente que se hace llamar "Mr. E".
Yoshi busca en las páginas de la enciclopedia varias criaturas e interactúa con ellas. Cuando Yoshi encuentra un personaje, puede usar sus habilidades para resolver acertijos. Por ejemplo, Yoshi puede tragarse una criatura desconocida para aprender más sobre ella o tratarla con comida para cambiar la habilidad de un nuevo amigo. Entonces, si le das una manzana a una rana, comenzará a soplar grandes burbujas. El mundo dentro de las páginas de la enciclopedia está animado en un estilo tradicional de animación stop-motion, con una velocidad de cuadros más baja para ciertas acciones de los personajes, como saltar.

es.title: Orbitals [NUP][RUS/Multi10]
es.voice_lang: Inglés, Japonés, Chino, Francés, Alemán, Español, latinoamerikanskaya Español, Portugués brasileño
es.description:
Una aventura espacial multijugador para dos con el espíritu del anime clásico. Maki y Omura son exploradores que necesitan ir más allá de una misteriosa tormenta y encontrar ayuda para su estación espacial.
Cada héroe tiene sus propias herramientas y tareas. Uno puede controlar la nave mientras el otro dispara, y tendréis que trabajar juntos para resolver acertijos y superar peligros. Podéis jugar juntos en una consola o en línea; No hay modo para un solo jugador.

es.title: Kollektsiya Carafe/Wine-NX/Box64/Autorun-portov dlya konsoli Nintendo Switch [NRO][RUS]
es.description:
Sombras siniestras y una oscuridad infinita se instalaron en los largos pasillos de la base militar, donde el mal ha hecho su guarida. Sus emisarios sedientos de sangre llenaron oficinas, almacenes y laboratorios secretos. Tu tarea es simple hasta el punto de caer en desgracia: limpiar la base militar de inmundicia a cualquier precio. Tendrás explosivos para lidiar con extraños teletransportadores que arrojan miles de criaturas malvadas, y armas estacionarias te ayudarán a proteger las áreas despejadas. Tienes acceso a las armas de más alta tecnología desarrolladas por la humanidad. Gana dinero y compra nuevas armas mortales e implantes biomecánicos que pueden convertir a cualquier imbécil en un superhombre.
Rendimiento: alrededor de 60 fotogramas sin overclocking

es.title: Mega Man X Regenesis (homebrew) [NRO][ENG]
es.description: Un proyecto de fans creado por Justin Ross: la acción se desarrolla en una línea temporal alternativa después de los acontecimientos de Mega Man X. Sigma ha ganado, X ha caído y la humanidad ya está al borde de la extinción. Y justo cuando parece que toda esperanza está perdida, el Dr. Kane revela su último plan: ¡Proyecto Regénesis! Ante una última oportunidad de reescribir la historia, X debe resucitar y comenzar su lucha para salvar los restos de la humanidad.

es.title: Hard Time III (3) / Old School / Wrestling Empire / Infinite Lives (Mat Dickie, MDickie) [NSZ][ENG]
es.description:
Bursting into the 3rd dimension brings new powers with unprecedented freedom, as a combat system perfected by wrestling is taken to new heights. An ambitious control system supercharges EVERY button, creating a spectrum of abilities that are easy to enjoy yet difficult to master.

Create your own origin story, as you try to survive in a city dominated by supernatural violence and discover who you really are. Develop powers that make you MORE than human, or lose the spirit that makes you LESS than human - in a vicious cycle that never ends! Find your place among hundreds of other heroes and villains, each trying to rule the world with their own unique powers. Fight over every corner of the map to secure it for your chosen cause, as allegiances change as often as your costume! The city's dozens of locations are filled with hundreds of fully interactive weapons and destructible scenery to add to the action.

Upon discovering every character's secret identity, you can make the world you own by saving your changes in the editor. You can then blow off steam in "Fight Scenes" - where you decide WHO fights WHERE and with WHAT! And when it's time to roam back into the city, you'll have the privilege to start each new life fine-tuned to your liking with more and more options unlocking infinite possibilities.

es.title: Prototype 2 (port ) [NRO][RUS/ENG]
es.description: Un virus mortal que se ha liberado ha convertido la metrópoli en el umbral del infierno. Dividida en zonas de seguridad, la ciudad se ha convertido en una enorme trampa. Algunas de las calles están controladas por militares, que destruyen cualquier manifestación de la infección. Las áreas restantes se han convertido en una "zona roja", la morada de mutantes que devoran sin piedad a sus víctimas. En algún lugar, entre los edificios destruidos, se esconde Alex Mercer, el principal culpable de la propagación del virus. Y ahora también se dirige allí el ex sargento James Heller, ansioso por vengar a su familia, que murió en los primeros días del cataclismo. Bienvenido a Nueva York Cero. La temporada de caza está abierta. La continuación del bestseller cruel y sangriento del estudio Radical Entertainment continuará la historia de la transformación de una persona en un arma absoluta. Causa estragos y destrucción en las calles de la ciudad utilizando las habilidades que te otorga el virus. Transforma el cuerpo del héroe absorbiendo numerosos enemigos. Utilice opciones de viaje ilimitadas para explorar las ruinas de New York Zero y vivir nuevas experiencias. Luchar. Matar. Cambiar. Sacrifica tu humanidad por un único objetivo: destruir... Alex... ¡Mercer!

es.title: Detention [NSZ][ENG]
es.description: Detention is a unique atmospheric horror game heavily influenced by Taiwanese/East Asian culture, religious elements and mythology. Based on the 1960s Taiwan under martial law, in this 2D atmospheric horror side-scroller, the player control characters who venture into the school beset by hostile supernatural events to uncover stories behind the haunted place. Incorporated the game provided players with unique graphics and gaming experience.

es.title: Hyrule Warriors Age of Imprisonment [NUP][ENG]
es.voice_lang: Japonés, Inglés, Francés, Español, Italiano, Alemán
es.performance: Sí (en emulyatore Switch 2 Eglantine v0.1.0-rc1 PGO)
es.description:
La trama del juego tiene lugar en el pasado y sirve como trasfondo de los acontecimientos de The Legend of Zelda: Tears of the Kingdom. Se centra en la historia de la princesa Zelda, quien es transportada al pasado distante que rodeó la formación de Hyrule y la Guerra de Prisión.
La jugabilidad mantendrá el estilo Musou tradicional de la serie, presentando batallas contra múltiples oponentes en vastos campos de batalla y presenta personajes nuevos y familiares que expanden el universo de la serie.

es.title: Kirby Air Riders [NUP][ENG]
es.interface_lang: Inglés, Japonés, Alemán, Francés, Español, Italiano, Portugués, Holandés, Coreano, Chino
es.voice_lang: Inglés, Japonés, Alemán, Francés, Español, Italiano, Portugués, niderlandskaya, Coreano, Chino
es.description:
Elige un corredor y un coche, acelera, deslízate por las curvas y ataca a tus oponentes. Air Ride presenta carreras de alta velocidad, Top Ride presenta carreras de arriba hacia abajo y City Trial implica explorar la ciudad de Skaia, recolectar potenciadores y prepararse para la prueba final en el estadio.
El modo para un jugador de Road Trip llevará a Kirby y otros corredores a una aventura con desafíos de todos los modos de juego. Juega solo, compite con amigos localmente o sal a la pista en línea.

es.title: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort [NUP][RUS/Multi16]
es.description:
¡Bienvenido a Spokko Resort en la isla Wuhu! Aquí se pueden practicar 12 disciplinas deportivas: boxeo, tenis de mesa, tiro con arco, tenis, voleibol, bolos, baloncesto, golf, lucha de pulgares, skate, carreras acuáticas y vuelo en avión.
Controla tus movimientos con el Joy-Con 2, explora la isla y compite con amigos o jugadores online. Crea un Mii o un Sportsmate, domina diferentes deportes e intenta ascender en las clasificaciones de la Pro League en línea.

es.title: Kynseed [NSZ][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
es.description:
Embárcate en una vida de aventuras en un hermoso mundo de creatividad e intriga. Forma una familia, personaliza tu granja, dirige un negocio, fabrica objetos y lucha contra monstruos.

Tus acciones y decisiones importan en nuestra historia llena de propósito y promesas. Echa una mano a los aldeanos necesitados y descubre la mezcla única de creatividad y elección que distingue a Kynseed. ¡Ven y únete a nosotros, tu legado te espera!

• RPG impulsado por la historia ambientado en hermosas regiones, donde lucharás contra criaturas de cuentos de hadas oscuros.
• Personaliza tu granja y casa de campo usando el modo de personalización de Kynseed con cientos de objetos y posibilidades de diseño ilimitadas.
• Asume el papel de tendero y dirige tu propia herrería, tienda de pociones, taberna o próspera tienda general.
• Desarrolla relaciones con los aldeanos que recordarán tus hazañas, acciones y bromas.
• Combate al malvado ejército de Hob mientras construyen poderosos tótems y causan la destrucción de cultivos y edificios.
• Reconstruye casas y edificios rotos para tus vecinos y nuevos NPCs.
• Recolecta materiales para crear objetos, forjar armas o mezclar curas para extrañas dolencias.
• Compra artefactos extraños del misterioso Sr. Fairweather: objetos que facilitan tus tareas, mejoran tus habilidades de combate o simplemente te permiten doblar las reglas del mundo. Pero cuidado con su impuesto de vida: cada uno cuesta años de tu vida.
• Un mundo donde todos envejecen: forma una familia y luego ponte en los zapatos de tus hijos y continúa tu legado.

En Kynseed, vive tu vida como elijas en un mundo abierto 2D hecho a mano con amor.

es.title: Minecraft [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
es.description:
Minecraft es un juego que consiste en colocar bloques y aventurarse.

Explora mundos generados al azar y construye cosas increíbles, desde la más humilde de las casas hasta el más majestuoso de los castillos. Juega en el modo creativo con recursos ilimitados o extrae en las profundidades del mundo, crea armas y armaduras para defenderte de enemigos peligrosos en el modo supervivencia.

es.title: Escape From Mystwood Mansion [NSP][ENG]
es.description:
EXPLORE THE MANSION
You find yourself trapped inside the mysterious Mystwood Mansion. The door behind you is locked and the only way forward is to delve deeper into the mansion. As you explore the mansion's many rooms you discover that someone has orchestrated a series of puzzles and challenges to keep you from escaping.

SOLVE PUZZLES AND DECIPHER CODES
Each room of the mansion is filled with puzzles to solve and codes to decipher. As you take on the mansion's many challenges someone seems to be watching your every move...

INTERACT WITH THE ENVIRONMENT
Poke around to find clues to help you solve the puzzles. Interact and study 3D objects to find important details.

ESCAPE!
Will you escape the mansion's grasp or are you up to the challenge to access the final room?

FEATURES
• Five puzzle-filled rooms with hidden sub-areas
• Dynamic hint system
• Beautiful and immersive environments to explore
• Many objects and secrets to find
• Multiple endings

es.title: Crafty Survivors [NSZ][RUS/Multi4]
es.description:
¡Los héroes se corrompieron! Desbloquea un elenco variado de profesionales, usa sus habilidades únicas, crea configuraciones a tu gusto y acaba con las hordas de enemigos para defender tu hogar. ¡Busca materiales, reconstruye tu aldea y deja que el arte te guíe hacia el origen de la maldición!

CONFIGURACIONES DE PERSONAJE ÚNICAS PARA CADA NIVEL
Elige entre una gran variedad de mejoras en este roguelite de acción para crear configuraciones de personaje únicas que se adapten a cada partida. ¿Te convertirás en un chef que rostiza a los enemigos y sirve victorias para el postre? ¿O en una costurera que hilvana a sus enemigos y los destruye con bolas de estambre? ¿Qué material elegirás para tus estatuas? ¿Madera o mármol? ¡Descubre el arte de sobrevivir A TU MANERA!

ELIGE A TU ARTÍFICE
Escoge entre una gran variedad de artífices, que cuentan con habilidades y mecánicas únicas. ¡Aprovecha cada estilo de juego para disfrutar de una experiencia distinta en cada partida! Podrás cocinar a los enemigos, liquidarlos con tijeras gigantes o construir estatuas que aplasten a todo lo que se te interponga en el camino. ¡El arte del combate te ayudará a proteger tu hogar!

MEJORA LA ALDEA PARA VOLVERTE MÁS FUERTE
Reúne los materiales que los enemigos dejen caer y úsalos para mejorar la aldea, desbloquear personajes nuevos y conseguir más potenciadores que aumentarán aún más tu poder en combate.

DEJA QUE EL JUEGO SEA TU LIENZO
¡Elige si quieres usar las habilidades de forma automática o manual! Descubre cuáles funcionan mejor en cada modo y combina las configuraciones para adaptar el juego a tu gusto. ¿Prefieres el lanzamiento manual? ¿O que las habilidades se disparen solas? ¿Qué tal si combinas ambos estilos? ¡La decisión es tuya!

• Lucha en un conjunto diverso de biomas que te pondrán a prueba de distintas formas y evolucionarán con cada actualización.
• Elige entre una gran variedad de artífices y sorpréndete con los personajes que se sumen al elenco mediante actualizaciones.
• Descubre los árboles de habilidades de cada personaje, que contienen más de 300 técnicas y talentos para combinar. 
• Diviértete con las partidas rápidas, que serán convenientes para las personas más ocupadas.
• Aprovecha el Sistema de Alimentos para personalizar tu experiencia de juego aún más.
• Explora el Sistema de Herrería y el Sistema de Tejido, que añaden 80 habilidades pasivas más con las que podrás adaptar el estilo de juego de cada personaje.

es.title: Valkyrie Tune Synthesis of Souls [NSZ][ENG]
es.description:
Un entrelazamiento de destinos llenos de amor, tristeza y encuentros fatídicos conduce a un reinicio para el futuro. Te encontrarás en el papel de Ray, que recupera el sentido en la "Ciudad Domo" llamada Initium. Está rodeado de mujeres que lo llaman "Mesías". Tratando de recuperar los recuerdos perdidos durante años de criosueño, Ray comienza a vivir con seis hermosos miembros del escuadrón TUNED (Unidad Táctica para Neutralización y Defensa Mejorada). Estas chicas utilizan las llamadas "armas armónicas" en la batalla.
Te espera una historia profunda y emotiva: el personaje principal, que ha perdido la memoria, conoce a seis encantadoras heroínas. Sus destinos entrelazados, llenos de amor, tristeza y encuentros icónicos, se convierten en los presagios de un reinicio que definirá el futuro. Conoce personajes encantadores, pasa tiempo con ellos, ríen juntos... ¡hasta que un giro inesperado en la trama ponga tu mundo patas arriba!

es.title: Wild Blue Skies [NSP][ENG]
es.description: Un moderno juego de disparos arcade sobre raíles diseñado tanto para principiantes como para veteranos del género. ¡Despega, lucha y conquista los cielos con los Blue Bombers!

es.title: Dungeon of Dragon Knight Remake [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
es.description:
¡El clásico juego de mazmorras regresa como una nueva versión completa para Nintendo Switch! Explora mazmorras, resuelve acertijos, lucha contra monstruos y descubre secretos olvidados...
Reúne tu propio escuadrón y adéntrate en las profundidades de peligrosas mazmorras llenas de monstruos, trampas, acertijos y secretos ocultos. Examina cuidadosamente el entorno, encuentra pasadizos y mecanismos secretos, recoge armas, armaduras y objetos útiles y desarrolla a tus héroes durante las batallas. El juego combina movimiento basado en cuadrículas con combate en tiempo real, desarrollo de personajes, gestión de equipos y resolución de acertijos. Cada héroe tiene sus propias habilidades y rasgos, por lo que elegir la composición y el equipo del escuadrón adecuados es la clave para sobrevivir en las próximas pruebas.
La nueva versión conserva las características clave del original, al tiempo que mejora significativamente las imágenes, los controles y la calidad general del juego.

es.title: Rumbral [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
es.description:
DESCUBRE RUMBRAL

Te despiertas en un bosque oscuro y misterioso, sin recordar quién eres ni qué haces allí. Avanza por un mundo lleno de estructuras abandonadas y puzles, quizás dejados por otros. ¿Supervivientes? ¿Exploradores? Encuentra extraños líquidos magenta que te permiten descubrir secretos del pasado… y tal vez también de ti mismo. Pero ten cuidado: puede que no estés solo en este lugar desolado.

VIAJA ENTRE REALIDADES

A lo largo de tu camino en Rumbral, te encontrarás con unos extraños charcos de color magenta, los cuales te permiten viajar a otra realidad. Alterna entre estas realidades paralelas para influir en ambas y avanzar.

RESUELVE MISTERIOSOS PUZLES

El camino no siempre será fácil: tendrás que resolver distintos obstáculos que se interponen para poder seguir adelante.

ENCUENTRA COLECCIONABLES

Durante tu aventura, te toparás con objetos coleccionables especiales, algunos más ocultos que otros. Recolectarlos te permitirá descubrir la historia de este mundo.

es.title: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time (2026) [NUP][RUS/Multi16]
es.voice_lang: Inglés, Japonés, Francés, Alemán, Italiano, Español, latinoamerikanskaya Español, Portugués brasileño
es.performance: Sí (en emulyatore Switch 2 Lichii 22.1.8 so spetsialnym patchem dlya zapuska okariny)
es.description:
Ganondorf está buscando la Trifuerza y ​​el joven Link debe proteger a Hyrule. Junto con el hada Navi, emprenderá un gran viaje para descubrir los planes de Ganondorf y convertirse en el Héroe del Tiempo.
Explora Hyrule, resuelve acertijos, lucha contra enemigos y toca la ocarina para cambiar el curso de los acontecimientos. El remake actualizó los gráficos y la música, agregó voces en off, diálogo ampliado, saltos y carreras y controles de cámara modernos.

es.title: Star Fox [NUP][ENG]
es.performance: Sí (en emulyatore Switch 2 Lichii nx2 build 70 286117c PGO)
es.description:
Un shooter sobre raíles en tercera persona en el que los jugadores controlan varios vehículos pilotados por Fox McCloud. Fox, el hijo del difunto líder del equipo original de Star Fox, James McCloud, lidera un nuevo equipo de Star Fox que debe evitar que el villano principal del juego, el loco Doctor Andross, destruya el Lylat Star System.
Como una nueva versión de Star Fox 64, el juego conserva una jugabilidad y controles similares. Al controlar The Arwing, los jugadores completan el nivel automáticamente. Deben defenderse de los enemigos y maniobrar entre obstáculos utilizando diversas armas, como láseres y bombas, o realizar maniobras acrobáticas como saltos mortales y giros.
El juego está dividido en niveles, con inserciones de historia entre ellos, en los que las acciones de los jugadores afectan el final y el desarrollo general de la historia. Durante el paso de niveles, el jugador puede protegerse con un escudo de plasma, que puede restaurarse recogiendo anillos de oro y plata. Al completar tareas relacionadas exclusivas de cada nivel, puede recibir recompensas adicionales.

es.title: Cat Astrophy [NSZ][RUS/Multi11]
es.description: Cat-Asnomy combina combates trepidantes, plataformas precisas y configuraciones únicas en un Action Roguelite espacial, donde cada carrera crea nuevos desafíos y nuevas formas de jugar. Domina el cursor estelar, explora planetas generados procedimentalmente y descubre el misterio que rodea a Polo, cada vez más fuerte con cada expedición.

es.title: Warrior Cats Clans of the Forest Feral Edition [XCI][ENG]
es.description:
Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest es un inmersivo juego de acción y aventuras ambientado en la naturaleza salvaje e indómita de la popular serie de libros Los gatos guerreros.

Embárcate en una gran variedad de misiones para ganarte el favor de tu clan y enfréntate a otros en combates por turnos para fortalecer a tu gato y hacer crecer tu leyenda. Aprende nuevos movimientos de combate para derrotar a tus rivales. Enfréntate a una gran variedad de enemigos, como ratones, ardillas, tejones y muchos más, todo ello antes de llegar a las épicas batallas contra jefes finales. Explora el territorio y encuentra materiales que podrás utilizar para fabricar artículos en tu madriguera. Recorre territorios emblemáticos, como los frondosos bosques del Clan del Trueno, las ciénagas del Clan del Río, los oscuros pantanos de pinos del Clan de la Sombra y los páramos abiertos del Clan del Viento. Tu aventura también te llevará a los famosos lugares sagrados como el Estanque de la Luna y la Isla. Trepa a los árboles, ábrete paso entre la maleza, sigue rastros olorosos, resuelve acertijos ambientales y descubre los misterios del propio Clan Estelar.

UNA HISTORIA ORIGINAL
Embárcate en una nueva aventura con los gatos y los escenarios más emblemáticos de la saga Los gatos guerreros.

CREA TU PROPIO GATO GUERRERO
Con el potente creador de gatos, crea y pon nombre a tu propio gato guerrero.

CARACTERÍSTICAS DEL JUEGO:
* 3 modos de juego: Modo Profecía, Modo Defensor y Modo Escaramuza.
Modo Profecía: Cuatro historias originales sobre las pruebas y dificultades de la vida en el clan.
Modo Defensor: Pon a prueba cuánto tiempo eres capaz de aguantar mientras luchas contra los enemigos más feroces del juego en una sola partida.
Modo Escaramuza: Lucha contra otros jugadores en línea de forma no simultánea.
* Crea tu propio gato guerrero único con millones de posibles combinaciones de personalización.
* Seis lugares emblemáticos de la serie de libros: el territorio del Clan del Trueno, el territorio del Clan del Río, el territorio del Clan de la Sombra, el territorio del Clan del Viento, el Estanque de la Luna y la Isla.
* Sistema de combate por turnos con batallas de hasta 3 contra 3.
* 75 movimientos de combate únicos por descubrir y desbloquear.
* Interactúa con 9 gatos de la querida serie de libros.
* Lucha contra una gran variedad de enemigos, entre los que se incluyen tejones, feroces zorros, imponentes dóbermans, gatos de clanes rivales y muchos más.
* Rastrea y caza aves, conejos, ardillas y otras presas.
* Visita el campamento de tus amigos en línea de manera asincrónica.
* También puedes ayudar a tus amigos fabricando objetos o regalándoles los recursos y materiales que necesiten.
* No hay dos partidas iguales, ya que los personajes, las misiones y las historias se generan de forma procedural.

es.title: Hello Kitty Party Land [XCI][ENG]
es.description:
Únete a la fiesta en Party Land y forma equipo con encantadores personajes de Sanrio, para disfrutar juntos de un montón de emocionantes minijuegos.

• Sumérgete en el universo de Sanrio
¡Reúnete con más de 145 personajes favoritos y colecciona sus stickers! Alíate con uno de los 15 personajes jugables de Sanrio y úsalo como tu avatar o tu mejor compa de equipo.

• Forma equipo y diviértete con emocionantes minijuegos
Pásatelo en grande con más de 45 minijuegos junto a tus amistades, ya sea online o sin conexión. Elige el modo Juego de mesa y vive momentos de pura acción con minijuegos rápidos, mientras esperas a que llegue tu turno.

• Personaliza tu avatar
Diseña un personaje único. ¡Personaliza absolutamente todo: desde el peinado hasta la ropa, y desbloquea muchos objetos a medida que avanzas en el juego!

es.title: Splatoon Raiders [NUP][ENG]
es.description:
En islas llenas de misteriosos remolinos, tendrás que dar una lección a los salmónidos y encontrar tesoros. Son los "Fish Paste Gang", los que más adoran los tesoros, y el personaje principal, "Mechanic", quienes hacen un aterrizaje de emergencia aquí: iban a ir en helicóptero a las "Islas Whirlpool" para encontrarlos.
Además de las armas, el mecánico puede equipar y mejorar "accesorios" para contrarrestar el salmón.

es.title: Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave [NUP][ENG]
es.interface_lang: Inglés, Alemán, Francés, Español, Italiano, Japonés, Coreano, Chino
es.description:
En el Imperio Dagda se llevan a cabo Juegos Heroicos: al ganador se le promete un deseo. Entre los participantes hay cuatro héroes, cada uno con su propio objetivo. Kai quiere liberar a su padre, Dietrich busca un oponente digno, Theodora sueña con el futuro de su tierra natal y Leda está impulsada por una sed de venganza.
Sus historias se entrelazarán con el destino del mundo. Dirige escuadrones en batallas tácticas por turnos, cambia el curso de los acontecimientos y ayuda a los héroes a afrontar la amenaza inminente.

es.title: Donkey Kong Bananza [NUP][RUS/Multi17]
es.voice_lang: Ruso, Inglés, Alemán, Francés, Español, Italiano, Chino, Coreano, Japonés
es.description:
¡Ábrete paso destruyéndolo todo con la fuerza de Donkey Kong! Atraviesa paredes, crea túneles con tus puños, desciende por el suelo con tus golpes e incluso arranca y arroja bloques de terreno para romper las barreras de la exploración. En esta innovadora aventura entre más destruyas, más áreas estarán disponibles para avanzar.  

Únete a Donkey Kong y su compañera, Pauline, mientras exploran las profundidades y descubren que este mundo subterráneo es mucho más de lo que parece. ¡Devela una variedad de entornos como áridos cañones, frondosos bosques y tundras congeladas mientras exploras los estratos del mundo!

Únete a Pauline para activar las transformaciones de la Bananza 

La joven Pauline es una talentosa cantante que intenta regresar a la superficie ¡y su voz puede activar las transformaciones de la Bananza de Donkey Kong! Cada transformación tiene sus propias cualidades: puedes destruir los obstáculos más resistentes con la fuerza bruta de la transformación Kong, galopar a toda velocidad con la transformación Cebra y más.

Forma equipo con un amigo en el modo cooperativo para dos jugadores y exploren el mundo subterráneo como Donkey Kong y Pauline. El segundo jugador puede destruir enemigos y terreno con el poder de la voz de Pauline mientras exploran juntos.

Ábrete camino destruyendo todo para llegar al Centro del planeta antes que la empresa Void Company

Se dice que el Centro del planeta tiene el poder de conceder cualquier deseo, y Void Kong, el despiadado líder de la ambiciosa empresa Void Company, no se detendrá ante nada para llegar ahí y apoderarse de las riquezas del mundo. Sin embargo, Donkey Kong y Pauline tienen otros planes, pero si quieren que sus deseos se vuelvan realidad, tendrán que vencer a Void Kong.

¡Únete a Donkey Kong y Pauline en una disparatada aventura repleta de acción mientras te abres paso al Centro del planeta!

es.title: Fast Fusion [NUP][ENG]
es.performance: Sí (en emulyatore Switch 2 Eglantine nx2 build 206 c54bc22)
es.description:
Fast Fusion es el juego de carreras antigravitatorias más rápido que jamás hayas experimentado.

Conduce tu vehículo antigravedad por circuitos brillantes como el hermoso bosque de secuoyas, el planeta tempestuoso Tempesta o las elevadas alturas de Yama Crest.

¡Usa la emocionante habilidad «Fusión»! La «Fusión» te permite crear cientos de máquinas de carreras mejoradas fusionando tus vehículos favoritos en otros nuevos, con especificaciones mejoradas y aspecto único.

Arriésgalo todo dominando la nueva tecnología de hipersalto antigravitatorio para adelantarte a tus oponentes.

es.title: Godzilla Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered + DLC [NSP][ENG]
es.description:
Controlarás a los kaiju, monstruos japoneses gigantes, y lucharás en espacios amplios. Hay disponibles un total de 12 luchadores con diferentes técnicas cuerpo a cuerpo, ataques de energía y ataques especiales en modo furia. El entorno también participa en la batalla: edificios y otros objetos pueden usarse como armas contra el oponente.
Para las batallas se han preparado ocho localizaciones con opciones de día y de noche. Entre ellos se encuentran ciudades, Monster Island y un barco alienígena. Los desarrolladores también cambiaron el sistema para desbloquear contenido: ahora se pueden desbloquear nuevos luchadores, arenas y materiales de galería en cualquier orden.
¡Y para cada monstruo hay una campaña separada para un jugador!...

es.title: Look Outside [NSZ][ENG]
